description: Open the Last Price integration code (the files generate_monetization_code writes) as a pull request in one of the workspace's own GitHub repositories, through the installed Last Price GitHub App. Commits to a new branch (last-price/billing-setup unless branch is given) and opens a pull request against base or the default branch; never merges, and refuses a branch that exists. Early access. Needs a Last Price credential with billing write scope and the App installed (get_github_app_connection). Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agent_id.description: One of your agents, filled into the code.

base.description: Branch to open the pull request against; the default branch when absent.

branch.description: New branch for the commit; last-price/billing-setup when absent.

customers.description: Include creating customers at sign-up (default true).

event_name.description: The billable event the example records, like chat.completed.

repository.description: owner/name, like acme/agent-app; must be a repository the installation can use.

name: open_monetization_pull_request
